    Daily Report

    Sponsored by

    Tuesday, November 24, 2026

    11:45am

    Anyone see that white stuff flying on Saddleback today?

    You weren’t the only ones. Our snowmaking crew has officially kicked of the 2026/27 winter season, firing up the guns and getting the mountain ready for opening day. Before long, we’ll be loading chairlifts, caving fresh corduroy, and doing what we do best.

    In the meantime, the Tune Shop is officially open for the season.  Dust off those skis, bring them down, and let the best tuner east of the Mississippi, Jake, work his magic. Already ahead of the game? Head up to The Pub, grab something good, and watch the snowmaking crew work their magic right from the mountain.

    Whale tails are starting to take shape, and the holiday savings are in full swing. Our Black Friday Season’s Greetings and Cyber Monday sales are your last chance to save big on season passes, ticket packs, lift tickets, and lessons. Don’t sleep on these deals!

    Winter is happening. Opening day is December 4. We can’t wait to welcome you home to Maine’s Favorite Mountain.

    UPCOMING EVENTS

    • December 4 – Opening Day!!!
    • December 19 – Santa at Saddleback

    Looking for our current Hours of Operation all across the mountain? Head to this page: Hours of Operation – SaddlebackMaine.com
